summary: Tested the per-city business landing (/business/{slug}), the lead capture API, admin visibility of leads, city-ads status, and the build_posts unit. Backend: 17/17 pytest pass. A sweep of all 81 campaign slugs (27 top + 54 wave2) found the business city API and the hero/job images resolving for every one. Frontend: Riyadh page renders the hero image, the Arabic RTL line (dir=rtl), the headline 'Get more local customers in Riyadh.', 4 benefit cards and the form. Client-side errors work (missing category, then missing phone/email). Submitting saves the lead with UTMs and navigates to /register?role=provider&recruit_city_slug=riyadh-sa&name&email&phone, and the register name/email/phone fields are prefilled. Not-found state works; London has no local line; Tokyo on mobile shows no horizontal overflow. POST /api/admin/city-ads/run was NOT called. All TEST_ business_leads deleted.

minor.issue: Public, unauthenticated insert with no rate limit or captcha, so it can be spammed and inflate the public 'businesses_joined' counter.
category is not validated against CATEGORIES (any string up to 60 chars is accepted). The city lookup ignores is_active, while GET /business/cities/{slug} does filter on it.

issues: The prefilled register form sits ~1339px down the page (top of [data-testid=register-name]) under the 'Product tour' video block. A business owner arriving from the lead form sees a video, not the form they were just sent to. Consider scrolling to the form or hiding the tour when recruit_city_slug/name is present.

action_items: (Optional) Add rate limiting or a honeypot to POST /api/business/leads
(Optional) Validate category against CATEGORIES; filter is_active in the lead city lookup
(Optional) On /register, scroll to or show the form first when arriving from /business/{slug}
critical_code_review_comments: businesses_joined counts every raw lead (including spam or duplicates). Consider deduping by email/phone per city.
No duplicate-lead guard: the same business can be submitted many times.
seed_data_creation: None persisted. Created TEST_ business_leads (API + UI) and deleted them; business_leads collection count is 0.
